name: Toggl
label: Toggl Track API v9
description: Toggl Track API v9 via OfficialApiNode (nodes/toggl/api_spec.json). Official Toggl Track API v9. Basic auth: username is the API token, password is the literal 'api_token'. time_entry_create requires created_with (client identifier) in the JSON body. Official docs: https://engineering.toggl.com/docs/track/api/time_entries/. OUTPUT is {status, http_status, data} or {error}. Secrets never appear on OUTPUT.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Toggl official API call. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Set operation plus the path/query/body fields that operation lists in api_spec.json. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"time_entry_create"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP verb to run. Overrides instance operation when non-blank. EXACT accepted values: 'time_entry_create', 'time_entry_get', 'time_entry_update', 'time_entry_delete', 'time_entry_start', 'time_entry_stop', 'project_list', 'client_list', 'workspace_list', 'listen'. listen/trigger/webhook_listen never open a socket — they return an error telling you to use a BPMN message event. Example: 'time_entry_create'.

schema.label: workspace_id
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `workspace_id` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: description
schema.description: Time entry description. create / start / update. Example: Design review.

schema.label: start
schema.description: Start datetime ISO8601. create / start / update. Example: 2026-01-15T09:00:00Z. For start, duration should be -1.

schema.label: duration
schema.description: Duration in seconds. Negative (typically -1) means running. create / start. Example: 3600.

schema.label: project_id
schema.description: Toggl project id. create / start / update. Example: 123456789.

schema.label: time_entry_id
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `time_entry_id` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: created_with
schema.description: Client name required by Toggl on create/start. Example: studioquack.

schema.label: billable
schema.description: Billable flag. time_entry_create / start / update. Default false. https://developers.track.toggl.com/docs/api/time_entries

schema.label: tags
schema.description: Tag names. time_entry_create / start / update. Example: ["client-a"].

schema.label: tag_ids
schema.description: Tag ids. time_entry_create / start / update. Example: [123,456].

ports.name: output
ports.description: Handler result object. Success: status='ok', http_status, data (parsed JSON). Example: {"status":"ok","http_status":200,"data":{}}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT value: 'ok'. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or the raw string when not JSON. Example: {}.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default official API call for this instance when input.operation is blank. EXACT accepted values: time_entry_create, time_entry_get, time_entry_update, time_entry_delete, time_entry_start, time_entry_stop, project_list, client_list, workspace_list, listen. Default: time_entry_create. Example: time_entry_create.

configurationParameters.label: Api Token Password
configurationParameters.description: Provider credential for auth.type=basic (configKey api_token_password). REQUIRED secret — StudioQuack secret binding only; never put this on INPUT. Never logged. Example: 'redacted-token'.

configurationParameters.label: Api Token
configurationParameters.description: Basic-auth username field (api_token). Toggl API token used as the Basic username. Secret. Example: 'xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx'.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for the official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Example: 25.
